scientific_role: raw public-layer primitive to unit-interval structural component adapter

general_rules.unit_interval_inputs: WorldCover fractions and precomputed graph-support columns must already lie in [0,1].
general_rules.terrain_rank_rule: Where a monotone terrain direction is source-justified, use deterministic within-declared-frame percentile ranks; no fitted cut point.
general_rules.graph_rule: Ecological continuity/component scores are not reconstructed from convenient rasters in this adapter. They must come from a separately pinned ecological graph builder.
general_rules.human_access_rule: Roads, trails, permissions and accessibility cannot enter structural raw adapters; they belong to G_F after ecological candidate construction.
general_rules.outcome_columns: Field outcome, detection, tissue and identity-result columns fail closed.

WETLAND_MOISTURE_STRUCTURE.topographic_moisture_score: min(inverse percentile rank of tpi300, inverse percentile rank of slope100)
WETLAND_MOISTURE_STRUCTURE.terrain_continuity_score: validated pass-through of terrain_continuity_score_raw from ecological graph builder

ALPINE_TOPOGRAPHIC_STRUCTURE.relative_relief_score: percentile rank of elevation within the declared candidate frame; high values support alpine-relative relief

COASTAL_ISLAND_STRUCTURE.shore_position_score: exp(-coast_distance_m / 1000 m); fixed monotone transform, not field-fitted

GENERAL_SPATIAL_BASELINE_ONLY.rule: No ecological component may be added after field outcome.

source_layer_mapping.terrain_primitives: reuse the outcome-blind GSI DEM extraction semantics already implemented in research/campanula_microterrain_discovery.py (elev, slope100, tpi300 and related diagnostics), generalized to the declared Cirsium private frame
source_layer_mapping.worldcover_primitives: reuse the outcome-blind ESA WorldCover neighborhood-fraction semantics already implemented in research/campanula_worldcover_discovery.py at 250 m
source_layer_mapping.coast_distance: must be produced by a separately pinned coastline source/adapter before coastal private-frame freeze
source_layer_mapping.graph_support: must be produced by the next ecological graph-builder gate; not inferred here

current_blockers_before_real_patch_token: pin ecological graph-builder semantics for continuity/component columns
pin coastline source and coast-distance extraction
build private candidate frames for the frozen 13 validation units
run HMAC patch freeze before opening any field outcome
claim_boundary: These transforms operationalize predeclared structural evidence. They do not estimate occupancy, adaptation, causal habitat effects or field yield.
